property_summary: For any depositor and any deposit amount, if a malicious recipient re-enters during withdrawBalance's external call the reference contract always results in address(c).balance decreased by the withdrawn amount (i.e., no extra Ether remains in the contract after a successful withdraw), whereas the mutant that zeroes after the external call can be drained/left with a larger-than-expected contract balance due to reentrancy and thus violates that invariant for some inputs.
change_summary: Move zeroing of userBalance to before the external call so balance is set to 0 prior to sending Ether (prevents reentrancy affecting refunded amount).
